cells.gaps: No survey puts account holding at four in five adults, or gives the share paying digitally. The GSMA's 62% names no survey, and a Findex 2025 report leaves about 46% with a bank account.
cells.note: The newest figure, the GSMA's of October 2026, puts adults with a mobile money account at 62%, over half. Nothing puts account holding at 79% or more, so not stage 4.
